intro: Find the best coffee machine in Bangladesh, from simple drip makers to cafe-grade espresso.
html:
Walking into a Dhaka cafe makes great coffee look easy. Making it at home feels harder. Drip or espresso? Beans or ground? Do you need a grinder, a milk frother, or a 15 bar pump?

That's why we put this coffee machine buying guide together. If you're searching for the best coffee machine in Bangladesh, you'll find seven of the best options here. They range from a simple coffee maker for your morning jug to a commercial machine for a busy cafe. Each coffee maker gets plain notes on what it does well and where it falls short.

You'll also find a quick comparison table, a short buying guide, and answers to common questions. Read the picks first, or jump to the guide if coffee machines are new to you. Either way, you'll know what to look for before you spend money.

Top 7 Best Coffee Machines in Bangladesh

Here are the seven coffee machines, ordered roughly from entry level to premium. The mix covers the best coffee machine for home and the best espresso machine in Bangladesh for different budgets. One commercial option is included for cafes. At Star Tech, check the different types of coffee maker & machines at competitive prices and warranties before you buy.

Philips HD7432

Some mornings you just want a jug of coffee and no fuss. The Philips HD7432 does exactly that. Fill the 0.6 L tank, add ground coffee, and press one switch. A full jug takes about 10 minutes. The aroma twister swirls the coffee inside the glass jug, so the first cup tastes like the last. The drip stop lets you pour before brewing ends. The Philips coffee maker uses 700 W and shuts itself off 30 minutes after brewing.

Key Feature

  • Type: Drip coffee maker
  • Coffee input: Ground coffee
  • Brewing: Drip, about 10 minutes for a full jug
  • Capacity: 0.6 L water tank, 2 to 7 cups
  • Milk system: None
  • Built-in grinder: None

The Philips HD7432 drip coffee machine is best for singles and couples who want a simple daily drip coffee.

DeLonghi EC230 Stilosa

Curious about espresso but nervous about the cost? The DeLonghi EC230 Stilosa is a gentle way in. It has a 15 bar pump, a stainless steel boiler, and a manual steam wand for frothing milk. You add ground coffee, tamp it, and press the button. The two-level drip tray fits mugs and glasses up to 110 mm tall. Frothing takes a little practice, but once you get the hang of it, a home cappuccino gets easy.

Key Feature

  • • Type: Semi-automatic espresso machine
  • • Coffee input: Ground coffee
  • • Brewing: 15 bar pump, 1,100 W
  • • Capacity: 1 L water tank
  • • Milk system: Manual steam wand
  • • Built-in grinder: None

The DeLonghi EC230 Stilosa coffee maker machine is the best for first-time espresso buyers who don't mind learning to froth milk.

DeLonghi EC785 Dedica Metallics

The DeLonghi EC785 Dedica Metallics suit people who like options. It brews from ground coffee or E.S.E. pods, which are pre-measured coffee discs. Use a pod on a rushed weekday, then switch to ground coffee on a slow weekend. The thermoblock holds the water at the right temperature for espresso. With this DeLonghi coffee machine, you also get a 15 bar pump, a 1.1 L removable tank, and an adjustable steam wand for cappuccino or caffelatte. The drip tray fits cups up to 12 cm tall.

Key Feature

  • Type: Semi-automatic espresso machine
  • Coffee input: Ground coffee or E.S.E. pods
  • Brewing: 15 bar pump, Thermoblock heating
  • Capacity: 1.1 L removable water tank
  • Milk system: Adjustable steam wand
  • Built-in grinder: None

The DeLonghi EC785 Dedica Metallics espresso machine Best for home users who want pod convenience and the option to use ground coffee.

Philips EP2220/10

This one is for people who want fresh-bean coffee without the fuss. Pour beans into the 275 g hopper, tap the touch display, and the Philips EP2220/10 grinds, brews, and pours. Choose espresso or coffee, pick one of three aroma strengths, and set the amount. The ceramic grinder has 12 settings, and Philips rates it for about 20,000 cups. For milk, you froth by hand with the classic steam wand. A separate chute takes pre-ground coffee. Philips says its AquaClean filter stretches descaling to 5,000 cups if you replace it when prompted.

Key Feature

  • Type: Fully automatic espresso machine
  • Coffee input: Whole beans or pre-ground coffee
  • Brewing: 15 bar pump, touch display
  • Capacity: 1.8 L water tank, 275 g bean hopper
  • Milk system: Classic steam wand
  • Built-in grinder: Yes, 12 ceramic grinder settings

The Philips EP2220/10 is a fully automatic espresso machine, best for beginners who want fresh-ground coffee and don't mind frothing milk by hand.

Philips EP3343/31

If milk drinks are your thing, look at the Philips EP3343/31. Its LatteGo milk system has two parts and no tubes. Philips says you can clean it in about 10 seconds. One touch gives you espresso, coffee, cappuccino, latte macchiato, or iced coffee. Hot water for tea is there too. Five aroma strengths and a 12-step ceramic grinder help you dial in the taste. Philips also says SilentBrew makes it 40% quieter than its earlier models. The HomeID app adds recipes and tips.

Key Feature

  • Type: Fully automatic espresso machine
  • Coffee input: Whole beans or pre-ground coffee
  • Brewing: 15 bar pump, touch display
  • Capacity: 1.8 L water tank, 275 g bean hopper
  • Milk system: LatteGo, 0.26 L milk container
  • Built-in grinder: Yes, 12 ceramic grinder settings

This Philips EP3343/31 is a fully automatic coffee machine Best for families and cappuccino or latte fans who want milk drinks with little cleanup.

DeLonghi PrimaDonna EABI 6600

The PrimaDonna EABI 6600 does something the others can't. It slides into your kitchen cabinetry, so the DeLonghi coffee machine looks like part of the wall. The 13-setting conical grinder handles the beans. Then it makes cappuccino, latte, or flat white at the touch of a button. The integrated milk carafe froths for you, and a self-cleaning cycle handles the rinse. You can brew two cups at once and save favorite drinks with the memory function. Plan the space first.

Key Feature

  • Type: Fully automatic built-in machine
  • Coffee input: Whole beans or ground coffee
  • Brewing: 15 bar pump, two cups at once
  • Capacity: 1.8 L water tank, 250 g bean hopper
  • Milk system: Integrated milk carafe with automatic cappuccino system
  • Built-in grinder: Yes, conical burr, 13 settings

This DeLonghi PrimaDonna EABI 6600 is a fully automatic built-in coffee machine, best for people building or remodeling a kitchen who want a flush-fit machine.

Nuova Simonelli Aurelia Wave 2 Group

This one belongs in a cafe, not a flat. The Aurelia Wave 2 Group has two groups, so two baristas can pull shots at the same time. The 14 L copper boiler supplies steady steam and hot water. PID temperature control and a rotary pump keep each shot consistent. Volumetric dosing and double pre-infusion repeat the same shot all day. The touch screen lets you save brew profiles, and the 58 mm brass portafilters are commercial grade. Plan the setup carefully. The Nuova Simonelli coffee machine connects to a water line and draws about 4.5 kW at 220 V, so ask an electrician to check your circuit. Nuova Simonelli also says unsoftened, unfiltered water voids the warranty.

Key Feature

  • Type: Commercial espresso machine, 2 groups
  • Coffee input: Ground coffee (58 mm portafilters)
  • Brewing: Rotary pump, PID temperature control, plumbed-in water
  • Capacity: 14 L copper boiler
  • Milk system: Steam wand
  • Built-in grinder: None, you need a separate commercial grinder

This Nuova Simonelli Aurelia Wave 2 Group is a Commercial espresso machine is best for cafes and restaurants with medium to high daily volume.

Which Coffee Machine Fits Your Needs?

Still deciding? Match your coffee habit to a machine. If you want a simple daily jug, pick the Philips HD7432. To try espresso without much fuss, go for the DeLonghi EC230 or EC785. Beginners who want fresh beans from a touch screen will like the Philips EP2220/10. For cappuccino and latte, pick the Philips EP3343/31. Planning a coffee machine built into your kitchen? The PrimaDonna EABI 6600 sits flush in the cabinetry.

Small offices have two good routes. The Philips EP3343/31 pours single cups, while a drip maker fills a jug for the team. Running a cafe? The Aurelia Wave 2 Group is the one to pick.

Not sure which one fits your kitchen? Browse the coffee machine at Star Tech and compare the specs side by side. Check the coffee maker product page for the current price and warranty before you order.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQS)

Question-1:

What is the best coffee machine in Bangladesh for home use?

The Philips EP3343/31 is the best all-rounder for home, with one-touch milk drinks and easy cleanup. For plain drip coffee, pick the Philips HD7432.

Question-2:

Which is the best espresso machine for beginners?

The DeLonghi EC230 Stilosa is the easiest way to start. The DeLonghi EC785 Dedica Metallics is better if you also want pod convenience.

Question-3:

Do I need a separate grinder?

Not with the Philips EP2220/10, Philips EP3343/31, or DeLonghi PrimaDonna EABI 6600, which have built-in grinders. The other models need pre-ground coffee or a separate grinder.

Question-4:

Should I choose a drip or an espresso machine?

Choose drip for a simple, larger jug of coffee. Choose espresso for strong shots and milk drinks like cappuccino and latte.

Question-5:

Which coffee machine makes milk drinks with the least cleanup?

The Philips EP3343/31. Its LatteGo system has two parts and rinses clean in about 10 seconds, according to Philips.

Question-6:

What is the best coffee machine for a small office?

Pair the Philips EP3343/31 for single cups with the Philips HD7432 for a shared jug.

Question-7:

Which coffee machine suits a cafe or restaurant?

The Nuova Simonelli Aurelia Wave 2 Group. It has two groups, so two baristas can work at once.

Question-8:

Can I build a coffee machine into my kitchen?

Yes. The DeLonghi PrimaDonna EABI 6600 is made for built-in installation, but plan the cabinetry first.

Where can I buy coffee maker at the best price and warranty?
